theorems.name: Submission.intcpt_allard_radial_field_divergence
theorems.statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (a : Euclidean N → ℝ) (y z : Euclidean N) (S : Grassmannian N n), DifferentiableAt ℝ a z → Varifold.tangentialDivergence (fun w ↦ a w • (w - y)) z S = n * a z + fderiv ℝ a z (Grassmannian.project S (z - y))
